verdict.rationale: Undermind documents one kind of recurring background automation: it monitors saved topics and notifies users when relevant papers are published, with role-aware alerts on enterprise plans. The autonomous deep-review agent that plans its own searches is a one-off, user-triggered run, not a recurring scheduled automation, so it adds little to this story. Missing for 10: user-configurable automations beyond topic alerts (custom schedules, triggers, or chained actions), documentation of how alerts are set up and configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration that background monitoring works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Get notified whenever relevant papers are published.
Role-aware alerts: Monitors saved topics and sends concise updates tailored to each teammate’s role and active projects.
Plans its own searches, follows citations and key authors, and stops only when new searches stop finding relevant papers.
